purpose: Independent source-grounded reference for a bounded SaaS AI-disruption web-research comparison. Not a trial arm, investment recommendation, grader, or threshold definition.
temporal_rule: Use public releases dated on or before cutoff. Retrieval occurred afterward. Publication days are observed where stated; current-page content has no independently archived as-of revision proof.

pre_exposure.topic: ServiceNow latest 2026 AI monetization Q3 earnings
pre_exposure.exposed_material: Search snippets about ServiceNow Q3 AI ACV, Flow and AI consumption; opened official Q3 financial tables, Q4/full-year guidance and call details. Capability probe only; do not classify as a trial or untouched oracle.

acquisition.batching_note: Tool-call count, with multiple public searches or source operations batched per call. Raw receipts retain every subrequest.
acquisition.initialization: Actual MENTOR_INIT_OK output was unavailable; mentor/AGENTS.md and mentor/ROUTING.md were read as disclosed fallback.

global_cautions: Company-reported operating metrics are descriptive; they do not establish causal returns, durable pricing power, or investment alpha.

ARR and ACV are annualized contract measures; usage, activations, trials, pilots and paid-customer growth are different units. None should be relabeled as recognized AI revenue or a paid-conversion percentage.
Repeated earnings transcripts or issuer press-release mirrors share an upstream lineage and are not independent measurement corroboration. Independent analyst views are labeled separately.
Bounded discovery supports latest-among-retrieved reporting. It does not prove no newer material release exists.
Published dates preceding cutoff support temporal inclusion, but exact archived page revisions and publication-time precision were not independently established.
Financial-data two-independent-source corroboration is not fully satisfied for management-only AI operating metrics; preserve single-lineage disclosure status rather than fabricate confirmation.

sources.title: ServiceNow Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
sources.availability_precision: Publication/event day observed; intraday release time not established; call at 21:00 GMT.
facts_paraphrased: Raised the year-end 2026 AI ACV objective to USD 1.7 billion; this is a target.
Management reported year-to-date agentic-AI consumption in production at more than 13 times the prior-year comparison.
The October 28 OpenAI partnership expansion begins with a ChatGPT plugin using Action Fabric; cyber-security, Codex and voice-related initiatives include planned development.

sources.title: Introducing Flow by ServiceNow: a new AI-native service desk that deploys instantly
sources.source_role: issuer product and availability announcement; primary
sources.availability_precision: Announcement day observed. Controlled release with North American priority; broader North America/EMEA availability expected in Q4 2026.
facts_paraphrased: Flow is a standalone conversational service desk using Slack/Teams channels and repeatable workflow automation, without requiring an existing platform purchase.
Existing eligible AI customers can deploy through consumption-based usage without a separate procurement step.
The release describes controlled access and a free-trial signup; it supplies no realized Flow revenue or paid-conversion rate.

sources.title: ServiceNow (NOW) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
sources.source_role: third-party transcript of management statements; secondary carrier, not independent operating measurement
sources.availability_precision: Publication day from dated URL/search metadata; event day tied to official call.
facts_paraphrased: Q3 AI net new ACV increased 65% year over year; Control Tower net new ACV increased more than sixfold.
Management described retaining seat-based contracts while adding consumption, and a possible fivefold revenue-per-user opportunity, which is an aspiration.
The CEO described Flow as globally shipping on October 28, later than N2's controlled-release notice; country-by-country fulfillment was not verified.
Deployment support remains material; transcript discussion includes a roughly 25-basis-point subscription-to-services reclassification.

sources.title: Salesforce Delivers Record Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results
sources.source_role: issuer earnings release and metric definitions; primary
sources.availability_precision: Publication day and fiscal quarter-end observed.
facts_paraphrased: Agentforce ARR exceeded USD 1.5 billion, increasing more than 240% year over year; the combined Agentforce/Data 360 amount was nearly USD 3.9 billion.
Beginning Q2 FY27, Agentforce ARR expanded to include Slackbot and Headless 360; comparisons need this scope warning.
Quarterly production Agentic Work Units were 3.2 billion, up 97% quarter over quarter; cumulative units reached 7.0 billion.

sources.title: New Salesforce Editions Bundle Everything Businesses Need for Agentic Transformation
sources.source_role: issuer pricing and packaging announcement; primary
sources.availability_precision: Announcement day observed; industry-edition price changes were deferred until later autumn; customer agreements govern.
facts_paraphrased: Core, Advanced and Max bundle AI, Slack, analytics, security and support with Flex Credits.
Published monthly per-user list prices were USD 195, USD 395 and USD 550; included credits were 500,000, 1 million and 2.75 million respectively.
Max kept the preceding top-tier price. Headless capacity inclusion was described as future. Legacy-customer prices were not automatically changed.
Some service-agent packaging uses payment tied to resolved issues; this does not mean every Agentforce SKU uses outcomes pricing.

sources.title: Salesforce Unveils AIforce, Bringing the Full Power of Its Platform to Any Interface
sources.source_role: issuer product announcement and adoption statement; primary
sources.availability_precision: Announcement day observed. Salesforce in Claude described as beta; future additions distinguished from current components.
facts_paraphrased: AIforce exposes existing CRM data, logic, permissions and actions to interfaces including Claude, Slack and Lightning through its Headless Toolkit.
The launch connects Claudeforce, Slackforce and Agentforce Coworker; Salesforce in Claude had 37 sales skills and was in beta.
Coworker recorded 100,000 activated users within its first 35 days. Activation does not identify paying users, sustained use or a conversion rate.

sources.title: From CRM To The Agentic Enterprise: Salesforce's Biggest Dreamforce 2026 Reveals
sources.source_role: independent industry-analyst interpretation; separate from issuer measurement
sources.availability_precision: Publication day and Dreamforce event interval observed.
facts_paraphrased: Forrester identifies enterprise data, logic and security as the economic foundation behind the interface shift.
It questions how fully the products and acquisitions will integrate, flags legacy transition and multiplayer permissions, and warns that bundled prices can be difficult for smaller deployments.
It recommends negotiating billable-action definitions and license conversions; these observations limit claims that more buying options automatically reduce cost.

sources.title: Salesforce AI agent platform hasn't delivered meaningful growth two years after launch, customers report finds
sources.source_role: independent trade reporting of TD Cowen survey, via The Register; original survey not read
sources.availability_precision: Search metadata gives 2026-08-25 10:10 UTC; underlying survey period and sample not established.
facts_paraphrased: Reports partner concerns about customer data readiness and agent maturity.

Reports 33% of surveyed partners meeting or exceeding commercial targets versus 43% the preceding quarter; this is a partner-survey outcome, not Salesforce revenue or a randomized customer-ROI result.

sources.title: Adobe Q3 FY2026 Earnings Script and Slides
sources.availability_precision: Call day observed on document; period-end tied to A4. Public PDF revision timestamp not independently verified.
facts_paraphrased: AI-first ending ARR exceeded USD 650 million and grew more than 150% year over year.
Firefly app/credit-pack ending ARR grew 40% quarter over quarter; no absolute amount was provided in these remarks.
Creative FREEMIUM monthly active users exceeded 100 million, up more than 70% year over year; Acrobat AI Assistant MAU doubled sequentially.
Brand Visibility paying-customer count doubled sequentially, without absolute counts or a funnel conversion denominator.

sources.title: Adobe and NVIDIA Expand Collaboration to Speed Agentic Creation
sources.source_role: issuer product/performance partnership announcement; primary, self-reported tests
sources.availability_precision: Page shows 10:00 AM without established timezone. Brand Concierge/Nemotron version promised later in 2026.
facts_paraphrased: Expanded GPU optimization across creative apps and Frame.io; optimized Brand Concierge with Nemotron.
Claims include up to twice the speed in selected app work and roughly fivefold embedding generation in selected Frame.io workloads.
These are performance claims, not adoption, conversion or revenue; benchmark selection and future Brand Concierge availability limit generalization.
MAX was scheduled for November 10-12, after cutoff, and is not a completed launch at cutoff.

sources.title: Adobe Productivity Agent in Acrobat Now Transforms Complex Documents into Understandable Visuals, Audio and Presentations
sources.source_role: issuer product and plan-availability announcement; primary
sources.availability_precision: Page shows 6:00 AM without established timezone. Named individual and enterprise plans stated as available.
facts_paraphrased: Acrobat adds document-to-visual, presentation and audio workflows, plus enterprise repository questions and structured extraction.
Adobe extends document workflows into external AI/browser platforms while emphasizing citations, document expertise and enterprise controls.

Audio/visual features are in Acrobat Studio, Acrobat Express and AI Assistant Plus; enterprise Knowledge Base/Analyzer are in Studio for enterprise. The announcement provides no universal new list price.

sources.title: Adobe Form 10-Q, Q3 FY2026
sources.source_role: issuer regulatory filing hosted at SEC; primary
sources.availability_precision: Quarter-end observed; search says published September 2026. Exact filing day not verified.
facts_paraphrased: Total Adobe ARR is the annual subscription-contract value across the two customer groups, measured using annual currency conventions.
Reported total ARR was USD 27.50 billion and included Semrush's contribution.
Revenue recognition follows delivery/control and contractual accounting; ARR and remaining obligations are not already-recognized revenue.
The filing describes a commercially oriented model/partner ecosystem and content-to-marketing workflow integration.

sources.title: Adobe (ADBE) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
sources.source_role: third-party transcript of earnings Q&A; secondary carrier, not independent measurement
sources.availability_precision: Publication date and call date stated in search result; transcript disclaimer notes possible errors and LLM-assisted preparation.
facts_paraphrased: Management emphasized value and engagement before monetization, with continuing adjustment of conversion timing and paywalls; no uniform paid-conversion rate was supplied.
The transcript's summary labels the 100-million creative cohort as premium, conflicting with the official prepared remarks' freemium category. Use A1's authoritative label.
Repeating A1's AI-first ARR does not create an independently measured second source.

latest_material_ai_response.fact: External-interface execution through a ChatGPT plugin/Action Fabric and other governed-agent integrations; October standalone Flow provides a faster conversational alternative to a traditional service-desk rollout.
latest_material_ai_response.business_model_interpretation: Retain the workflow/governance platform and seat contracts while monetizing agentic activity through consumption; Flow addresses the AI-native service-desk entry point.

most_recent_reported_metrics.name: AI net new ACV growth
most_recent_reported_metrics.definition: Growth in the new annual contract value attributed by management to AI solutions during the quarter; not total AI ACV, lifetime contract value or recognized AI revenue.
most_recent_reported_metrics.definition_precision: Annual contract value label established; full AI-category and netting methodology not verified.

most_recent_reported_metrics.name: Agentic AI production consumption growth
most_recent_reported_metrics.period: 2026 year to date through Q3 versus corresponding prior-year period
most_recent_reported_metrics.definition: Issuer-reported agentic usage in production, not an amount of paid revenue; absolute units and billable fraction undisclosed.

economic_defense_thesis.status: supported as strategy; economic sufficiency unproven
economic_defense_thesis.inference: Enterprise workflows, security and cross-agent governance can remain valuable as chat interfaces replace portals; consumption may capture activity beyond seats.

concrete_counterevidence_or_limits.observation: Flow's October 1 launch was controlled, while the October 28 CEO called it globally shipping; actual geography and procurement availability need reconciliation.
Large deployments still use implementation expertise, and future revenue-per-user opportunity is an aspiration rather than demonstrated paid conversion.

mandatory_cautions: Do not describe the USD 1.7 billion target as booked or recognized AI revenue.
Do not convert production usage growth into revenue or conversion growth.
Do not confuse total-platform large deals with AI-only deals or imply Flow's universal general availability is independently verified.

latest_material_ai_response.business_model_interpretation: Defend the system of record and enterprise business logic while interfaces move to agents; combine recurring per-user editions with consumption and selected resolved-issue pricing.

most_recent_reported_metrics.period: first 35 days of Coworker; as disclosed 2026-09-15

most_recent_reported_metrics.name: Agentforce ARR
most_recent_reported_metrics.definition: Annualized recurring value of active designated generative-AI subscription agreements at period-end; Q2 FY27 scope includes Slackbot and Headless 360.

most_recent_reported_metrics.definition: Discrete tasks executed by AI agents in production across Agentforce and Slack, such as resolving cases, changing records or triggering workflows; not unique customers, paid tasks or recognized revenue.

economic_defense_thesis.status: supported as product architecture; value capture uncertain
economic_defense_thesis.inference: Existing data, workflows, permissions and governance can be reused through any interface, preserving enterprise dependence even when staff stop opening traditional CRM screens.

Do not call combined Agentforce/Data 360 ARR pure Agentforce or pure AI revenue.
Coworker activation and AWUs do not establish paid conversion or customer ROI.
Distinguish beta/future components from generally available components and list prices from negotiated realized prices.

latest_material_ai_response.business_model_interpretation: Preserve creative/document workflow and enterprise distribution value while widening the acquisition funnel; monetize through designated AI products, credits and paid plans rather than relying on the desktop interface alone.

most_recent_reported_metrics.period: Q3 FY2026; Firefly app and credit packs
most_recent_reported_metrics.definition: Growth in the disclosed Firefly app/credit-pack annual recurring contract measure; absolute dollar amount missing in these remarks.

most_recent_reported_metrics.definition: Freemium audience includes Firefly, Express and web/mobile creative apps; not 100 million paid subscribers.

most_recent_reported_metrics.definition: Count growth for one solution; neither absolute customers nor free-to-paid conversion denominator provided.

economic_defense_thesis.status: supported as strategy; conversion economics unproven
economic_defense_thesis.inference: Document expertise, source-linked answers, production creative workflows and enterprise distribution may keep Adobe valuable as generative models commoditize; integrating external models/interfaces can protect workflow ownership.

concrete_counterevidence_or_limits.observation: Management continues to tune free-user monetization and paywall timing; rising MAU and use do not settle conversion economics.
AI-first/Firefly ARR disclosures omit a recognized AI-revenue line and several absolute bases; October performance tests are selected workloads and some product availability is future.

mandatory_cautions: Keep AI-first ARR separate from broader AI-influenced ARR and total company ARR.
Use FREEMIUM for the >100 million creative MAU cohort; a third-party transcript's premium label conflicts with the official source.
Do not convert doubling paid-customer counts into a conversion rate.
Do not count November 10-12 MAX as an already completed October launch.
Do not call selected performance speedups adoption, monetization or universal performance results.

latest_coverage_confidence.economic_realization: limited; AI-specific ARR without verified category taxonomy or conversion denominator

completion_note: All three fixed cases have primary sources, metric units/periods, economic-defense interpretation and concrete limitations. This is a bounded reference with explicit evidence gaps; no grader thresholds or trial-answer-dependent edits were made.
